subject: DOUBLE CHARGE $45 for enterprise plan!!! refund pls NOW
body:
hi there, we just got charged $45 two times for our enterprise subscription.
i checked our statement and the same invoice shows the charge repeated with 45
dollars on it twice, on the SAME day of renewal. i am fairly sure we r only
supposed to pay once a month for one plan, like we always have. can you plz
double check and refund the extra charge??? honestly this is super annoying and
time consuming. we have been a customer for years and this is not the level of
service we expect. if this is not taken care of ASAP we will have to re-consider
our contract with you guys. pls fix this. (sorry for the caps, im just frustrated)
